question: Identify the synonym of 'Hapless'
solution:
The correct answer is: **2 i.e. Unfortunate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Hapless"** refers to someone who is unlucky or unfortunate. (दुर्भाग्यशाली)
 
 
• **Example:** The hapless traveler lost all his belongings during the trip.
 
 
• **"Unfortunate"** is a synonym of "hapless" and also means unlucky or not favored by fortune. (दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण)
 
 
• **Example:** It was an unfortunate accident that caused the delay in our plans.
 
 
• Thus, "Unfortunate" correctly captures the meaning of "Hapless".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **2 i.e. Unfortunate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Lucky** (सौभाग्यशाली): Fortunate or favored by good fortune.
 
 
• **Example:** She was lucky to win the lottery on her first try.
 
 
 
• **Fortunate** (सौभाग्यशाली): Having good luck or receiving good things unexpectedly.
 
 
• **Example:** He was fortunate to have such supportive friends during tough times.
 
 
 
• **Content** (संतुष्ट): Feeling satisfied or at peace with what one has.
 
 
• **Example:** She was content with the small but cozy home she had built.
